When the fresh viewer fails to swap in, `tui` now prints the error and exits with `exitFailed`. It no longer falls back to the plain rows plus the "needs Go" note. I ran `go test .` in `src/quack`, and it passes. I did not run `./RUNME.sh check` or the full `go test ./...`.

- **Signature:** `tuiViewerOf` now returns `(string, string, error)`, in `src/quack/tui_verb.go`. A swap failure returns the error as the third value. Build failures and stamp-write problems still come back as the second value (the "why" text).
- **Verb:** `tuiVerb` prints that error and stops.
- **Tests:** I updated the existing `tuiViewerOf` callers for the third return value. A new test, `TestTuiSwapFailureFailsLoudInsteadOfPlainRows`, holds every aside name so the swap fails. It checks that `tuiViewerOf` returns an error and that the verb exits with `exitFailed`, writes to the error stream, and prints no "needs Go" note.

The change is committed on the current branch as `5f4e9f2`.
